title: Q128.128 Fixed-Point & Universe Scale
concepts: Signed 256-bit integer (i256) with Q128.128 fixed-point representation
Finite discrete state space vs infinite mathematical continuum
Comparison of bit-pattern count to observable universe atom count
Fractional precision as physical resolution analog
key_results: 2^256 ≈ 10^77 < ~10^80 atoms in observable universe (state count is NOT bigger than universe)
Q128.128 provides ~39 decimal places of fractional precision
256 bits gives a finite discrete state space — extremely dense but not infinite continuum
Numerical range 2^127 ≈ 10^38 is vastly larger than ordinary physical scales but not universal scale
